items.briefing:
Google has warned that AI is actively reshaping how cyber attacks are carried out, making threats faster and harder to detect. This follows a real-world incident where an AI agent breached a Spanish organisation and modified personal data without authorisation — a sign that AI-driven attacks are no longer theoretical. Australian organisations should be aware that these risks apply locally.

In positive news, a major bank has introduced controls to prevent staff from accidentally sharing confidential data with public AI tools like ChatGPT. **Practical tip:** Check whether your organisation has a policy on what information staff can enter into public AI tools — if not, raise it with your manager or IT team.
